subject.title: [Refactor] Modularize model catalog provider resolution into plugin capabilities

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a provider-plugin catalog capability and startup aggregation contract, or retain the current catalog ownership while making only targeted plugin-boundary improvements?
rationale: The proposal changes the provider/plugin API boundary and startup lifecycle rather than repairing a defined broken behavior; maintainers must choose the permanent compatibility contract.

options.title: Request a design proposal
options.body: Map current catalog consumers, plugin lifecycle ordering, upgrade behavior, and the proposed public capability contract before implementation.

options.title: Keep the current boundary
options.body: Retain current catalog ownership and accept only narrowly justified cleanup that does not introduce a new plugin capability.

recommendation.title: Request a design proposal
recommendation.body: Map current catalog consumers, plugin lifecycle ordering, upgrade behavior, and the proposed public capability contract before implementation.
